topic: Side point from the Kizaru long: on Sabaody his first move was a call to Sentomaru, not a fight, and his sloppy Den Den Mushi and mangrove habits show the same pattern of caring about one person
title: Kizaru's First Move On Sabaody Wasn't A Fight
description: Before any battle on Sabaody, Kizaru tried to reach Sentomaru, the boy he trained. This Short looks at that first call, the pirate who shot at him, and why the question he asked afterward says more than his usual shrug. Was he really just careless, or was there a plan?
comment: Was Kizaru's Sabaody call to Sentomaru a plan, or just carelessness?

lines.text: Kizaru's first move on Sabaody wasn't a punch at all.

shot.fallback: anime admiral in yellow suit landing on a Sabaody island, sunlight, anime style

lines.text: He tried calling Sentomaru first, and the call didn't go through.

shot.search: Borsalino Den Den Mushi call Sabaody
shot.fallback: anime admiral holding a black Den Den Mushi snail phone to his ear, anime style

lines.text: Then a pirate fired straight at his head.

shot.fallback: anime pirate aiming a gun at an admiral on a Sabaody street, anime style

lines.text: The bullet passed right through him, and he barely reacted.

shot.fallback: anime admiral unbothered, bullet passing through his light body, anime style

lines.text: He walked over to the pirates and asked if they'd seen Sentomaru.

shot.fallback: anime admiral asking a group of pirates a question, relaxed pose, anime style

lines.text: Here's my read: that question tells you who he was really looking for.

shot.fallback: anime admiral and young bodyguard with axe, tense gaze, anime style

lines.text: The pirates ran, and his beam flattened a whole Yarukiman Mangrove.

shot.fallback: anime giant mangrove tree toppling over a Sabaody street, dust cloud, anime style

lines.text: He called it an accident, then brushed it off like nothing happened.

shot.fallback: anime admiral shrugging beside a fallen tree, lazy grin, anime style

lines.text: Same man who kept talking into the wiretap Den Den Mushi after being told.

shot.fallback: anime admiral speaking into a black Den Den Mushi on his wrist, anime style

lines.text: And that's only half of why Sentomaru still calls him uncle.

shot.fallback: anime young bodyguard with axe and admiral in yellow suit, warm lighting, anime style

lines.text: Which is why Kizaru's first move on Sabaody was a phone call, not a punch.

shot.fallback: anime admiral with a snail phone in a quiet Sabaody street, anime style

self_check.hook: Kizaru's first move on Sabaody wasn't a punch, stated as a surprise before the call and the bullet.
self_check.loop: Last line 'Kizaru's first move on Sabaody was a phone call' leads into line 1's 'first move on Sabaody'.
